jobs.name: fabbrica-cammina
jobs.prompt: Re-shoot this scene from a new camera angle: a cinematic low three-quarter side tracking shot that follows the same man as he walks slowly forward along a production line inside a large modern food processing factory. The factory fills the whole frame: long stainless steel conveyor belts carrying red apples, sorting machines, stacked crates, high ceiling with industrial lights, clean epoxy floor. Nothing of the original room remains. Keep the man identical: same face, glasses, beard, white linen shirt with rolled sleeves, grey shorts. Natural walking motion, realistic industrial lighting, steady camera. No text, no logos.
